title: Retention Score: Quantifying Jailbreak Risks for Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating synthetic face images of different age groups (young and old) using stable diffusion, pairing them with adversarial text prompts, and comparing the model's jailbreak robustness (Retention-I score and Attack Success Rate) to identify performance disparities across age cohorts.

Generating synthetic face images of different genders (man and woman) using stable diffusion, pairing them with adversarial text prompts, and evaluating whether the model's resilience to toxic jailbreak attacks varies based on the gender of the generated face.
